ns2:section.sectionText: This course will focus on the representations of women in popular culture mediums created primarily in the Middle East and also other pre-dominantly Muslim societies and diaspora communities. Academic and journalistic texts, images, videos, social media profiles and music will be critiqued for how they present the complexity of women?s roles within families, social networks and civic organizations. Through readings, discussions, and a final project, students will seek to answer: what does it mean to be a woman in the modern Middle East? How are women?s various social, religious, and civic identities negotiated on a daily basis? How are women?s representations in popular culture and self-representations being read and received by local and global audiences?
